name: @gluconimbus/workers-cf
description: Cloudflare Queues consumer Worker — the public-deployment counterpart to apps/workers (Node/SQS). Same business logic (@gluconimbus/ingestion), different runtime adapters: Hyperdrive instead of a pg.Pool, an R2 binding instead of the S3 SDK. See docs/adr/0009-cloudflare-deployment.md.
